correctness.rationale: The radial eigenvector \(x_v=\lambda^{|v|}/P_{|v|}\) gives sufficiency; Cauchy–Schwarz over every descendant layer gives necessity. Sparse count-preserving rearrangements yield long branching blocks and \(N(n)=\theta n+a\log_2(n+2)+O((\log n)^{1/4})\), controlling exact critical-series behavior. Long binary runs produce finite wavelet approximate eigenvectors for all \(|\lambda|<\sqrt2\). The forward adjoint has no eigenvalues, excluding residual spectrum. The finite checker passed 4,620 cases; this is supplementary to the infinite proof.
